title: Jammy Crisp Vietnamese Lamb Banh Mi
description: A low-glycemic-friendly Vietnamese dish featuring lamb, tempering-chocolate, and a jammy crisp texture, all in a convenient banh mi form.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together fish sauce, lime juice, and grated ginger.
Add the sliced lamb to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the marinade and cook in the oven for 20 minutes.
Melt the dark chocolate chips in a double boiler.
Temper the melted chocolate by cooling it to around 82 degrees Fahrenheit.
Spread a layer of the tempered chocolate on each banh mi loaf.
Top the chocolate with a few slices of the cooked lamb, some pickled carrots, and sliced cucumber.
Serve immediately and store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator.
Reheat the banh mi in the oven at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 5 minutes before serving.
